# single-trailing-newline

- ID: `MD047`
- Category: Whitespace and layout
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `blank_lines`

The file ends with a newline, or a last line of only whitespace, \> or comments.

## Why

Some programs mishandle a last line that has no newline. A last line with only
whitespace, \> or a comment counts as blank, as in markdownlint.

## Options

Set them under `rules.single-trailing-newline.options`.

- `max_trailing_blank_lines` (`integer`, unset by default, gomdlint only): Most
  blank lines allowed at the end of the file. Unset, any number is allowed.

## Fix

The fix adds a newline at the end of the file. gomdlint may report a finding
without a fix when the fix would change a line with one character in brackets,
such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it
could add or remove a task list checkbox. In a document with raw HTML other than
comments and plain br, wbr, hr or img tags, gomdlint reports every finding
without a fix.

## Configure

Under `rules`, `single-trailing-newline: false` turns the rule off and
`single-trailing-newline: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable single-trailing-newline` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line single-trailing-newline -->
```
